stem: Scaturro and Brown filmed their adventure most likely because they —

options.label: A
options.text: believed their journey down the Nile River would bring them more fame

options.label: B
options.text: hoped it would help promote efforts to clean and protect the areas along the Nile River

options.label: C
options.text: wanted people around the world to appreciate the beauty and diversity of the Nile River

options.label: D
options.text: thought the publicity would encourage more tourists to visit the Nile River
